visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair stands in a brightly lit kitchen environment. She wears a white t-shirt and a blue apron with red piping. She smiles warmly at the camera while holding a small green rectangular sachet. The background features a modern home interior with gold pendant lights and a tidy living area. (2) She uses metal scissors to cut open the green sachet and squeezes a yellowish oil into a small white ceramic bowl. The camera zooms in on her hands to show the pouring process. She then uses a small silver spoon to consume the oil directly, maintaining a happy facial expression. (3) The woman holds up a tall pink bottle of olive oil, showing the label to the camera. She pours a clear yellow liquid from the bottle into the white bowl. She takes another spoonful of the combined oils and drinks it, nodding with satisfaction. The background lighting remains bright and natural. (4) She introduces a pack of dried seaweed. She places a spoonful of the oil onto a dark green sheet of seaweed and spreads it evenly. She rolls the seaweed into a small cylinder and eats it, giving a thumbs-up gesture to indicate it tastes good. (5) Finally, she holds a pink mug with both hands and takes a sip of water. She smiles at the camera, concluding her morning gut health routine demonstration in the same kitchen setting.
